ASSISTANT: We have Standard at $15.49 - HD quality, 2 screens, 2 download devices. Or Basic with ads at $6.99 - HD quality, 2 screens, no downloads.
USER: What about the Standard without ads?
ASSISTANT: Standard without ads is the $15.49 plan I mentioned. Only our Basic tier has an ad-supported option.

ASSISTANT: According to the notes, you called about getting 4K quality for your new TV.
USER: Oh right, the living room TV. But honestly, I can't tell much difference.
